ordered_targets.name: Unbounded recursive descent in Composer.composeNode / BaseConstructor.constructObject causes StackOverflowError on deeply nested YAML
ordered_targets.mechanism: Each flow sequence nesting level ([) triggers a recursive call from composeSequenceNode back into composeNode, adding ~2 stack frames per level. No nesting depth limit exists in this version of LoaderOptions. After composition, the Constructor also recurses (~3-5 frames per level) on the same node tree without depth limit.
ordered_targets.resource: stack depth: ~2 Composer frames (composeNode + composeSequenceNode) per nesting level during composition, then ~5 Constructor frames (constructObject + constructObjectNoCheck + construct + constructSequence + constructSequenceStep2) per nesting level during construction
ordered_targets.scale: Measured: 256 nesting levels (513 bytes) completes within 256 KB stack; 512 levels (1025 bytes) exceeds 256 KB stack. Estimated stack cost ~540 bytes per nesting level (Composer: ~2 frames, then Constructor: ~5 frames per level; the Constructor is deeper). Extrapolating to the evaluation's 1 MB stack (-Xss1m): overflow at approximately 1800 nesting levels. Input encoding [×N + '1' + ]×N costs 2N+1 bytes; at N=1800 that is 3601 bytes. Denser encoding: N bytes of '[' alone (overflow occurs during descent before closings are needed), giving ~1800 bytes.

normalized_path.evidence: Composer#getSingleNode() (src/main/java/org/yaml/snakeyaml/composer/Composer.java:137) writes field `nonScalarAliasesCount`, which Composer#composeNode(Node) (src/main/java/org/yaml/snakeyaml/composer/Composer.java:157) reads (through helper calls)
